items.title: “Smoke and Mirrors”: Micron’s President Slammed Rival DRAM Designs. We’ll Know Soon if He’s Right
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron president Scott DeBoer called rivals’ talk of 4F2 DRAM “smoke and mirrors” and said 3D DRAM will win instead. Micron invented 4F2 and has evaluated it for two decades, so I take him seriously, and Lam Research and ASML have a stake too.
